title: Hold and align pipe flanges for horizontal pin insertion
instruction: Hold the loose pipe flange against the fixed flange and insert two pins horizontally in the top and bottom holes.
context: Pipework assembly requires holding mating flanges in alignment while temporary locating pins are installed.
setup: Fixed 150 mm diameter, 51 mm deep vertical CAD flange with 16 mm holes on a 55 mm bolt-circle radius, on a 100 × 54 mm pipe and 50 × 80 × 130 mm support. A 250 g loose flange, pipe stub, collar and side lug rest on supports of 60 × 80 × 56, 18 × 80 × 70 and 25 × 35 × 55 mm. Two 35 g pins have 50 × 14 mm shanks and 20 mm heads, lying parallel on two 50 × 28 × 185 mm supports. Parts are rigid steel-like solids; supports are rigid fixtures. Positions in task.py; no jitter; bimanual YAM station.
scoring: At the end, alignment within 3 mm and axes within 7.25° of the pipe earn 0.4. Add 0.3 for a pin in each of the top and bottom holes, axis within 7.25°, center within 4.5 mm radially and between 5 mm toward the head and 8 mm toward the tip from the mating plane. Only one pin counts per hole; without alignment the score is zero. Poses are scored, including while held.
reset_notes: Restore the fixed-layout object poses and both arms to the ready pose; no object jitter.
fidelity: Rigid CAD visuals with perforated collision approximations, a pipe stub and side lifting lug; approximate friction. No gasket, threads, clips, preload, deformation or fluid seal. Final poses do not measure gripper contact or prove unsupported retention.
